title: Portfolio and career — D4
purpose: Security and ownership for Portfolio and career: documented projects, decision logs, cost estimates, Terraform repositories, certifications, community, and release notes.
routing_rationale: Use the D4 lens to keep documented projects, decision logs, cost estimates, Terraform repositories, certifications, community, and release notes connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Build a credible architect portfolio from documented projects, decisions, cost models, Terraform, writing, and deliberate learning.

nodes.label: Documented Project
nodes.detail: A real or fictional architecture with a clear business outcome.

nodes.label: Decision Log
nodes.detail: The reasoning that makes the portfolio credible.

nodes.label: Cost Model
nodes.detail: A design that acknowledges unit economics.

nodes.label: Published Case Study
nodes.detail: A clear explanation for technical and executive readers.

nodes.label: Certification Sequence
nodes.detail: A learning plan that reinforces the portfolio.

nodes.label: Community and Release Notes
nodes.detail: External feedback and awareness of changing services.

scenarios.label: The portfolio shows commands but no decisions
scenarios.root_cause: A reviewer cannot see assumptions, rejected alternatives, or consequences.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Portfolio and career path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Decision Log and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Add ADRs and a design-review narrative to every project.

check.command: review d4 evidence for Decision Log

scenarios.label: The cost model cannot be checked
scenarios.root_cause: Pricing, workload size, or unit assumptions are absent.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Portfolio and career path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Cost Model and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Publish assumptions and a verification date, not a false precision.

check.command: review d4 evidence for Cost Model

scenarios.label: The portfolio ignores platform change
scenarios.root_cause: Service behavior, limits, or exam guidance has changed since publication.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Portfolio and career path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Community and Release Notes and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Track release notes and mark time-sensitive claims for re-verification.

check.command: review d4 evidence for Community and Release Notes
